dogecoin.text:
⚒️ Proof-of-Work: Fairer and More Cost-Rooted

Proof-of-work (PoW) networks like Bitcoin or Dogecoin require participants to burn real energy and invest in hardware to earn new coins. It’s hard to fake, and there’s no pre-mine or shortcut to power.
Dogecoin: Started as a fun experiment but has stayed true to a PoW system with broad community support.
